caption: The drawing features a single brown metallic object resembling an old-fashioned portable stove or burner. The object is cylindrical, with a slightly wider top that has an open, circular design, and a handle attached to the upper rim. Inside the top section are circular openings and raised sections, forming a pattern. The main body tapers downward and connects to three thin, angled legs for support. Extending from the base is a flat, rectangular plate with rounded edges, which is inscribed with text that reads “BRIDGE & BEACH.” The object appears rendered in different shades of brown, giving the appearance of aged or weathered metal, and the entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background. There is no other object or visual element present in the drawing.
title: Brazier
